workItem.title: Bridge-readiness: MIT runtime settings CLI validation readback IAU candidate

publicIssue.title: Admit runtime settings CLI validation readback IAU

targetGap.summary: The MIT authority can prepare the runtime-settings terminal surface and update governed provider/version/bitness settings, but it has no public import, Spec Kit feature, admission record, or clean-room validation readback contract for vihs --validate.

doNotAdmitTogether: no-argument interactive vihs selection and confirmation
live already-running VS Code session uptake proof
splitDecision.reason: Validation readback is the next useful step after settings-write, but interactive input, proof artifact generation, runtime execution, and release behavior carry separate proof and environment risks and should remain separate IAUs.

allowed: package identity vi-history / VI History / svelderrainruiz / MIT / 0.1.0
persisted provider, LabVIEW version, and LabVIEW bitness facts
runtime validation outcome facts such as outcome, provider, engine, blocked reason, error code, proof status, and implementation status
validation readback does not reopen path-picking, image-family selection, or panel-side provider picking
interactive selection, proof-out file writing, compare execution, runtime execution, live-session proof, packaging, and Marketplace publication remain blocked until separately admitted
blocked: private evidence roots or local filesystem paths
credentials, token names, or release credentials
source-copying instructions from another VI History authority
GitLab implementation source or private proof packets
active already-running VS Code session uptake proof
VSIX packaging, Marketplace publication, or release automation

candidateTasks: add tests for readback of persisted provider, LabVIEW version, and LabVIEW bitness facts
add tests for explicit effective settings target reporting
add tests for runtime outcome facts without LabVIEWCLI, Docker, compare, or proof-out file execution
add tests for fail-closed validation output when persisted settings are missing or unsupported
implement a pure public MIT validation readback/result contract
blockedTasks: no-argument interactive vihs selection and confirmation
live already-running VS Code session uptake proof
source copying from GitLab or GitHub Suite

allowedNextWork: create the public MIT import packet for runtime-settings-cli-validation-readback-v1
create the public Spec Kit feature spec, plan, and tasks
add public admission records with implementationStartAllowed false until preflight passes
run public redaction and artifact validation
notAllowedNextWork: implementing validation readback before public preflight
copying runtime settings implementation source from another VI History authority
adding VSIX packaging or Marketplace publishing
